name: Paradisus Grand Cana
insider_take: This sophisticated adults-only paradise sits on one of the Caribbean's most pristine stretches of white sand, where turquoise waters meet world-class luxury.
whats_special: The Paradisus Grand Cana is part of the exclusive Leading Hotels of the World collection and features the unique YHI Spa - one of the few thalassotherapy centers in the Caribbean using mineral-rich seawater treatments. The resort's Royal Service level offers butler service and access to exclusive areas, while the property sits on Bavaro Beach, consistently ranked among the world's top 10 beaches by TripAdvisor.
pro_tip: Book a sunset catamaran excursion to Saona Island - the resort's concierge can arrange private charters that avoid the crowded day tours, giving you pristine beaches and crystal-clear natural pools practically to yourself.
dont_miss: The Gabi Club beachfront restaurant for fresh ceviche and rum tastings, plus the nearby Indigenous Eyes Ecological Park - a hidden gem with 12 freshwater lagoons perfect for swimming, just 10 minutes from the resort.
pros: Expansive beachfront setting with direct access to a pristine Punta Cana shoreline
Luxury all-inclusive experience with world-class dining across multiple gourmet restaurants
Exceptional YHI Spa and wellness facilities offering transformative treatments and relaxation
Spacious, elegantly appointed suites featuring private terraces and premium resort amenities
Family-friendly offerings alongside exclusive adults-only Royal Service and The Reserve sections
cons: Large-scale resort property may feel expansive for guests preferring an intimate boutique experience
All-inclusive format limits spontaneous off-resort dining exploration
Remote resort location requires travel time from Punta Cana International Airport
